Grading Rubric (80 Points Total)

  • Conflict Adjudication & XML Integrity (4 pts / 32 pts scaled): The resolved XML file contains zero orphaned conflict markers and passes well-formedness and schema checks without data loss.
  • Validation Sweep Exhaustiveness (3 pts / 24 pts scaled): The terminal log confirms that all accumulated edition files (metadata, facsimiles, diplomatic transcription, normalized choice markup, reading stylesheets, lemmatization, named entities) were audited and passed with 0 errors.
  • Continuous Integration Reflection (3 pts / 24 pts scaled): The 300–500 word analysis insightfully discusses how automated CI checks and disciplined Git branching protect complex digital editions from configuration drift.
